questions: Should ward strength have a soft start, as L1 does? At equal W the Slow Breath beats the burst twin in a duel at Core and Deity, because attack past 200 is halved and ward strength is not.
Nothing prices a ward model, and this build stands on one: upkeep 0.10, the legal top, wins; a stress test at 0.20 loses. What should a per-pulse ward cost?
Nothing heals in a fight, so health is the only clock on an out-laster. Is that the intended end of rule 11?
